question: ‘Wings of Fire’ is an autobiography of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is ​__**A.P.J Abdul Kalam.**__

__**Key Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

__
 
• **A.P.J Abdul Kalam** was the President of India from 2002 to 2007.
 
• He served as the scientific adviser to the defence minister between 1992 and 1997.
 
• His birth anniversary is celebrated as National Innovation Day.
 
• He was an Indian scientist and politician who played a leading role in the development of India’s missile and nuclear weapons programs.
 
• His nickname was 'Missile Man'.
 
• In 1998, he put forward a countrywide plan called Technology Vision 2020 (road map for transforming India).
 
• He was sworn in as India’s 11th President in 2002.
 
• He put forward a countrywide plan called '**Technology Vision 2020**' in 1998.
 
• He is the first Indian President to travel to the** Siachen Glacier.**
 
• He is the first President of the Republic to cast a ballot in the Assembly election.
 
• In 1997, he was awarded the **Bharat Ratna award.**
 
• He died on 27 July 2015 during a speech at the Indian Institute of Management in Shillong, Meghalaya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "A Promised Land" is a memoir by **Barack Obama** published on November 17, 2020.
 
• "The Story of My Experiments with Truth" is **Mahatma Gandhi**'s autobiography, which spans his early infancy until 1921.
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar's **autobiography is titled "Playing It My Way."
